question: What is the effect of meditating on the sixfold path, given the Lord's nondual nature?
premises: Meditating on the sixfold path makes one become Shiva.
The Lord is not different from consciousness.
The concession introduces an apparent tension with spatial divisions.
inference: Meditation on the sixfold path leads to Shiva-identity even though the Lord transcends real spatial division.
plain_english: By meditating on the sixfold path one immediately becomes Shiva, even though that Lord, not different from consciousness, has no real divisions.
